evidence.title: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access

summary: Anthropic has enhanced its Claude Security platform with the Claude Mythos 5 model, enabling enterprise teams to perform advanced vulnerability scanning without direct model access. The update aims to streamline security workflows while maintaining controlled access to AI capabilities.
title: Anthropic Integrates Claude Mythos 5 into Claude Security for Enterprise Vulnerability Scanning
